form.label: PSIMS / SureView Signal Flow Health - v1
form.description: Starter dashboard for monitoring PSIMS/SureView signal flow, OpsLink health, queue aging, processing rate, and recent integration errors. Queue field names are placeholders until DB schema is confirmed.

search.query: index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" | eval created_epoch=coalesce(strptime(created_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),_time) | eval age_min=if(status="QUEUED",(now()-created_epoch)/60,null()) | stats count(eval(status="QUEUED")) as queue_depth max(age_min) as oldest_signal_min latest(eval(if(status="PROCESSED",_time,null()))) as last_processed_epoch | eval minutes_since_processed=round((now()-last_processed_epoch)/60,1) | eval health=case(queue_depth>=$queue_crit_tok$ AND oldest_signal_min>=$age_crit_tok$,"CRITICAL", oldest_signal_min>=$age_crit_tok$,"RED", queue_depth>=$queue_warn_tok$ OR oldest_signal_min>=$age_warn_tok$,"AMBER", true(),"GREEN") | fields health
index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" status="QUEUED" | stats count as queue_depth

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" status="QUEUED" | eval created_epoch=coalesce(strptime(created_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),_time) | eval age_min=round((now()-created_epoch)/60,1) | stats max(age_min) as oldest_signal_min

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" status="PROCESSED" | stats latest(_time) as last_processed_epoch | eval minutes_since=round((now()-last_processed_epoch)/60,1) | fields minutes_since

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Application" OR sourcetype="opslink:log" OR sourcetype="cloudlink:log") ("OpsLink" OR "CloudLink" OR "SureView Device" OR "SureView") (error OR failed OR failure OR exception OR disconnected OR offline OR timeout) | stats count as errors
index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" | timechart span=5m count(eval(status="QUEUED")) as Queued

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" | eval Incoming=if(event_type="CREATED" OR status="QUEUED",1,0) | eval Processed=if(event_type="PROCESSED" OR status="PROCESSED",1,0) | timechart span=5m sum(Incoming) as Incoming sum(Processed) as Processed

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" | timechart span=5m count(eval(status="QUEUED")) as queue_count | streamstats current=f window=1 last(queue_count) as previous_count | eval delta=queue_count-previous_count | eval state=case(queue_count=0,"HEALTHY", delta<0,"DRAINING", delta=0,"STALLED", delta>0,"GROWING") | eval stalled=if(state="STALLED",queue_count,null()), growing=if(state="GROWING",queue_count,null()), draining=if(state="DRAINING",queue_count,null()) | fields _time stalled growing draining

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" status="QUEUED" | eval created_epoch=coalesce(strptime(created_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),_time) | eval age_min=(now()-created_epoch)/60 | timechart span=5m max(age_min) as Oldest_Signal_Minutes

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ sourcetype="psims:signal_queue" status="QUEUED" | eval created_epoch=coalesce(strptime(created_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),_time) | eval age_min=round((now()-created_epoch)/60,1) | where age_min>=$age_warn_tok$ | sort - age_min | table signal_id created_time age_min status source queue_name component message

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Application" OR sourcetype="opslink:log" OR sourcetype="cloudlink:log") ("OpsLink" OR "CloudLink" OR "SureView Device" OR "SureView") | eval severity=case(match(lower(_raw),"error|failed|failure|exception|offline|timeout"),"ERROR",match(lower(_raw),"disconnect|retry|warning|warn"),"WARNING",true(),"INFO") | timechart span=5m count by severity

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Application" OR sourcetype="opslink:log" OR sourcetype="cloudlink:log") ("OpsLink" OR "CloudLink" OR "SureView Device" OR "SureView") (error OR failed OR failure OR exception OR disconnected OR offline OR timeout OR retry) | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table Time host source sourcetype component service_name message _raw | sort - Time

index=$idx_tok$ environment=$env_tok$ | stats count as events count(signal_id) as signal_id count(status) as status count(created_time) as created_time count(processed_time) as processed_time count(event_type) as event_type count(component) as component count(service_name) as service_name count(message) as message by sourcetype | sort - events
